objective: Make the SessionStart hook give the root rules to a session on legacy-only state and tell a main thread that is not the holyagent agent to read the root prompt and run all work through Intents and Assignments, and reinforce that rule wherever a session reliably reads it.
scope: Repository: /home/user/holyagent, branch claude/friendly-carson-g8dudb. The hook is packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts (`session-start`: today it returns nothing without a .holyagent folder, and prepends ROOT_CORE when payload.agent_type is not holyagent / holyagent:holyagent); the context builder is packages/runtime/src/cli/sessioncontext.ts (CONTEXT_BUDGET 9000, SESSION_REMINDER last); the core is packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root-core.ts (capped at 4,000 characters by a test); the reminder is packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/session-reminder.md; requirements.md is the model-agnostic source every instruction set is written from (change a behavior there first). Docs: docs/hooks.md describes session-start.

Reproduction this fixes: a cloud session on a project with `.holyclaude/` (4 Intents, 1104 Assignments) and no `.holyagent/` started as the default agent, not as holyagent; the hook printed nothing, so the session got no root rules and committed with raw git, implemented in the main thread and opened no Intent until the user complained. The same happened in the session that is writing this brief, on this repository with `.holyagent/` present: the main thread was not the holyagent agent and acted without the root rules until the user said so twice ('não POSSO sempre ter que falar para o root seguir as regras dele mesmo').

1. Legacy state: when `.holyclaude/` or `.holycodex/` exists at the state root and `.holyagent/` does not, the session-start context says which legacy folder was found, names `holyagent migrate` (with `--dry-run` first) as the way to convert it (a parallel Assignment is adding that command), and includes the core root rules and the most-missed-rules block, plus the new line of item 2. Without any of the folders the hook stays silent, as today.

2. Non-root main thread: confirm from the current Claude Code hooks documentation (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, SessionStart input and the agent_type field: it is present when the session uses --agent or the hook fires in a subagent; check what it holds when the plugin's settings.json `agent` setting selects the agent) which payload field tells the root from a plain session, and keep or fix the check accordingly; cite what you found. Confirm with a test that the existing core-rules path fires for a plain session payload (no agent_type) with `.holyagent/` present. Add one line to that path telling the main thread to read the holyagent agent prompt (`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agents/holyagent.md`, the hook already fills in CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) before acting and to run all work through an Intent and Assignments dispatched to the holyagent specialists, never implementing in the main thread.

3. Reinforcement the user asked for in this release: state the same rule (all work runs through an Intent and Assignments dispatched to specialists; the main thread does not edit or commit with raw git) in session-reminder.md, which ends every session-start context, and in requirements.md if it is not there already; and add a short line to the project AGENTS.md (which this repository's CLAUDE.md imports, so it reaches every session here even when no hook context arrives) saying that every session in this repository works as the holyagent root and reads packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md before acting. Keep each addition to one or two sentences, in the calm imperative style of the surrounding text (no capitals for emphasis); session-reminder.md stays a short block.

Tests: cover the hook output in three cases: legacy-only (each of .holyclaude and .holycodex), .holyagent with a non-holyagent main thread (no agent_type, and another agent_type), and neither folder (silent); keep the existing budget and size tests passing. The existing tests are in packages/runtime/tests/sessioncontext.test.ts, packages/runtime/tests/cli.test.ts and packages/integrations/claude/tests/hooks.test.ts.
Update docs/hooks.md for the new behavior.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md: Effect for effects and tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise or async functions in runtime source), Effect Schema at data boundaries, JSDoc on exports. Do not edit .claude/CLAUDE.md.

Edit only sources; do not edit generated files under packages/integrations/claude/dist (the root rebuilds them). Do not touch packages/runtime/src/cli/migrate.ts, state/legacy.ts, cli/commands.ts or docs/usage.md (another writer owns them).
Do not commit, branch, push or edit .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.
Do not add unrequested features, files or refactors; name them in the report instead.
Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When the work is done and checked, stop and report.

criteria.text: With .holyclaude/ or .holycodex/ and no .holyagent/, session-start emits context naming the legacy folder and `holyagent migrate`, with the core root rules and the reminder block; with no folder it prints nothing
A plain session payload with .holyagent/ present gets the core rules plus a line to read agents/holyagent.md and run all work through Intents and Assignments; the root agent_type does not
The payload field used to detect the root is confirmed against the current hooks documentation, with the source cited in the report
The rule is reinforced in session-reminder.md, requirements.md and AGENTS.md with short calm additions
Tests cover legacy-only, holyagent with a non-holyagent main thread and neither folder, and fail without the change; budget and core-size tests still pass
No change outside the hook, the context builder, the named instruction files, AGENTS.md, docs/hooks.md and their tests
